homology.detail: DIAMOND against reviewed UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot; GO and EC transfer.

names.detail: Input products retained; otherwise a putative Swiss-Prot product requires ≥40% identity and ≥80% query and subject coverage.

pathways.detail: KEGG module completeness is assessed per step from the module definitions (alternative enzymes, complexes, steps without a GO mapping) and counted only for modules the evidence activates; map coverage counts distinct EC-mapped functions as a breadth measure.

quality.detail: GSPA annotation completeness, ontology/taxon consistency and functional coherence using integrated scores ≥0.5. These assess annotations, not assembly contamination or experimental accuracy.
